stage0062_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$キヤル$$
「Is that one of $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s minions?!」

stage0062_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「To think they'd show up in $$カミナ$$ City too...!」

stage0062_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ニア$$
「It's all right.
　$$シモン$$ and the others are here.」

stage0062_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ギンブレー$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ forces cover all of $$カミナ$$ City now.」

stage0062_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「Leave the interception to them.
　Send the city defense corps to evacuate citizens.」

stage0062_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$'s army!
　They chased us all the way to $$カミナ$$ City!」

stage0062_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Doesn't look like $$グーラ$$ is around, though...」

stage0062_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$キタン$$
「Whoever they are,
　if they're scaring my cute niece,
　the great $$キタン$$'s taking 'em on!」

stage0062_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ギミー$$
「I won't lose to $$キタン$$!
　We'll protect $$カミナ$$ City ourselves!」

stage0062_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$キタン$$
「$$シモン$$!
　Come on, get fired up!」

stage0062_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「What are you doing!
　The enemy's right in front of you!」

stage0062_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「All units, intercept the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ army.
　$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ will hold this position
　and focus purely on defense.」

stage0062_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$田中司令$$
「This is hard to say, but...
　$$ＷＩＬＬ$$ isn't feeling well, sort of...」

stage0062_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$田中司令$$
「That being the case,
　$$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ is dead weight right now.
　Sorry for the trouble, everyone. Yes.」

stage0062_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「It's completely shut its heart away.」

stage0062_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Guess the sub-system can't handle combat...」

stage0062_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
（Contact with $$ロージェノム$$ seems to have backfired.）

stage0062_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Can't be helped!
　We'll do it ourselves!」

stage0062_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$赤木$$
「We'll protect the city that bears $$カミナ$$'s name!」

stage0062_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Something's off with $$グレンラガン$$.」

stage0062_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$ニア$$
「Could it be... the proposal earlier
　has something to do with it...?」

stage0062_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ギミー$$
「How's that, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$!
　Feel the weight of our strength!」

stage0062_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Let's head back, $$シモン$$.
　I can't stand watching you today.」

stage0062_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$キタン$$
「Days like this happen sometimes.
　Well... even if $$シモン$$'s off, with us around
　those punks are nothing to worry about.」

stage0062_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Ignorance truly is a frightening thing.」

stage0062_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You who trouble $$グーラ$$'s hand...
　and you, foolish Spiral King and Guardian
　of Order who side with earthlings: the time has come.」

stage0062_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Come forth, avatar of endless destruction!」

stage0062_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$隼人$$
「Summoning more $$インベーダー#keyword$$s again!?」

stage0062_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's right.
　I summoned part of a swarm from light-years away.」

stage0062_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You bastard!
　Sending more garbage down to Earth
　again, huh!」

stage0062_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「$$竜馬$$!
　Dealing with these guys comes first!」

stage0062_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「A space monster, breaching the atmosphere...!」

stage0062_04:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$キタン$$
「We'll smash 'em one by one!
　Not letting them have $$カミナ$$ City!」

stage0062_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
（Is the world... going to end like this...）

stage0062_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Damage to the city's been kept minimal!」

stage0062_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$隼人$$
「Time to go on the offensive!
　We can't keep wasting time
　on the likes of these!」

stage0062_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Ignorance truly is a frightening thing.」

stage0062_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「You who trouble $$グーラ$$'s hand...
　and you, foolish Spiral King and Guardian
　of Order who side with earthlings: the time has come.」

stage0062_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Come forth, avatar of endless destruction!」

stage0062_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$隼人$$
「Summoning more $$インベーダー#keyword$$s again!?」

stage0062_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「That's right.
　I summoned part of a swarm from light-years away.」

stage0062_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「They're going after anything within reach!」

stage0062_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$, you bastard!
　Sending more garbage down to Earth
　again, huh!」

stage0062_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$n
「$$竜馬$$!
　Dealing with these guys comes first!」

stage0062_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「A space monster, breaching the atmosphere...!」

stage0062_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$キタン$$
「We'll smash 'em one by one!
　Not letting them have $$カミナ$$ City!」

stage0062_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
（Is the world... going to end like this...）

stage0062_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Still resisting, are you.
　Then...」

stage0062_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$さやか$$
「Now even $$インベーダー#keyword$$s are here!」

stage0062_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ボス$$
「Even so, this is bad news!!」

stage0062_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ギンブレー$$
「Commander $$ロシウ$$!
　Let's evacuate the city!」

stage0062_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$ギンブレー$$
「At this rate, we'll be overrun before long!」

stage0062_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「Stop grumbling and just watch quietly!」

stage0062_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「$c and $$シモン$$ wouldn't give up
　over something like this!
　Those are people I believed in!」

stage0062_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「What's wrong, $$シモン$$?
　Going to betray his trust?」

stage0062_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$シモン$$
「Like hell I could do that!」

stage0062_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Hurry up and answer it.」

stage0062_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シモン$$
「We're in the middle of a fight!」

stage0062_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$ニア$$
「Hello, $$シモン$$?
　Sorry to call while you're busy.」

stage0062_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ニア$$
「I... just felt I had to tell you now...」

stage0062_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ニア$$
「Um... $$シモン$$ and I are different people.
　We always have been, and always will be.」

stage0062_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ニア$$
「But because we're different,
　I think we can live on together.」

stage0062_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ニア$$
「Thank you for this ring.
　I'm so happy!」

stage0062_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$シモン$$
「I did it!!
　Bro, I did it! I really, truly did it!!」

stage0062_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$ニア$$!!
　I swear, I'll protect you no matter what!!」

stage0062_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Congratulations, $$シモン$$!
　And you too, $$ニア$$!」

stage0062_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$葵$$
「Look at you, getting a yes right on the battlefield!」

stage0062_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$シモン$$
「How does everyone know about that!?」

stage0062_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Sorry, $$シモン$$.
　I accidentally left the comms open.」

stage0062_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ダリー$$
「This day's finally come, hasn't it.」

stage0062_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Bet $$カミナ$$'s smiling down on this from heaven.」

stage0062_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$スズネ$$
「This is making me happy, like it's my own!」

stage0062_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$グーラ$$
「That's right, Father.
　This is the power of humanity.」

stage0062_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, hey, $$グーラ$$!
　Taking advantage of the chaos to finish us off?!」

stage0062_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Father, wasn't the conquest of Earth
　entrusted to me, $$グーラ$$, after that battle?」

stage0062_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$グーラ$$
「For someone to scheme against $c
　like this, without my knowledge,
　is nothing but humiliation to me...!」

stage0062_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Very well, $$グーラ$$.
　It seems I overstepped this time.」

stage0062_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I will take my leave.
　Do as you please with the rest.」

stage0062_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't just stand there, $$正太郎$$.
　Let's finish off those monsters.」

stage0062_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$グーラ$$
「I won't let the likes of them
　do as they please with you. Whoever
　interferes with our fight gets no mercy.」

stage0062_04:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$! And $c!
　This is our first and last time fighting together!」

stage0062_04:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Got it, $$グーラ$$!
　Let's fight together!」

stage0062_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What's with that guy...!
　What a twisted attitude!」

stage0062_04:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$アスカ$$
「What's with that laugh?!
　It's so annoying!」

stage0062_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Don't fight!
　This is a scene of love and friendship!」

stage0062_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$ノリコ$$'s right!
　All that's left is to beat them!」

stage0062_04:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「So this is the power of organic life... humanity...」

stage0062_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「You too must understand this burning passion.」

stage0062_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「And there's only one line for a time like this...!」

stage0062_04:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ミサト$$
「All units, go on the offensive!
　We'll wipe out the enemy in one go!」

stage0062_04:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$シモン$$
「Wait for me, $$ニア$$!
　I'll finish them off and come get you now!!」

stage0062_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$正太郎$$
「We did it, $$グーラ$$!
　We won!」

stage0062_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I take back what I said, $$グーラ$$.
　You really are...」

stage0062_04:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea.
　I only dealt with what stood in my way.」

stage0062_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Farewell, $$正太郎$$.
　Next time, I'll destroy you all myself!」

stage0062_04:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$正太郎$$...
　Your feelings must be reaching $$グーラ$$.
　So don't give up hope.」

stage0062_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$田中司令$$
「No need to worry about $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ anymore, right?」

stage0062_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I caused everyone trouble.
　But I'm alright now.」

stage0062_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I will face $$ロージェノム$$ once more.
　And this time, I'll overcome my fear.」

stage0062_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「That's right, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$.
　We're not a flame flickering in the wind.
　We're the flame that lights the way ahead.」

stage0062_04:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「And even if each of us is a small flame,
　two together become a blaze...
　Layer enough of those, and it's a great fire.」

stage0062_04:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シモン$$
「That light will light up the future,
　and its heat will burn our enemies away.」

stage0062_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Thank you.
　I'll fight my hardest, keeping those words in mind.」

stage0062_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Heh heh... Those two are surprisingly in sync.」

stage0062_04:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$タケル$$
「I knew it. They really are friends.」

stage0062_04:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$グーラ$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, Earthling...!
　This is...」

stage0062_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Talk later, $$グーラ$$!
　Let's beat the enemy first!」

stage0062_04:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「You're thinking about needless things,
　$$シモン$$! Focus on the enemy at hand!」

stage0062_04:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let's do this, $$ヴィラル$$!!
　I'll protect $$ニア$$, $$カミナシティ$$, and the world!!」

stage0062_04:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$...
　Your faith in humanity... now I truly understand.」

stage0062_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So the wildness in you has awakened too.」

stage0062_04:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$田中司令$$
「The world isn't over yet.
　Not while this passion still burns.」

stage0062_04:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Now, let's go!
　Let our burning cry resound through this world!」

stage0062_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$'s with us too!
　We can't afford to lose this fight!」

stage0062_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's go, $$鉄人$$!
　Let's show them our true strength!!」

stage0062_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$グーラ$$
（Father... With my own strength alone,
　I will defeat $$鉄人$$ and $c, I swear...!）

stage0062_04:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$グーラ$$
（So please, believe in my power!
　I am your son, Father!）

stage0062_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キタン$$
「Bring it on, all of you!
　Don't think you can wreck $$カミナシティ$$ in front of me!」

stage0062_04:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$キタン$$
「Watch me, $$アンネ$$!
　I'll round these bad guys up, tie 'em up,
　and rough 'em up good, I promise!」

stage0062_04:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「In a city that bears his name,
　I can't afford to look pathetic...!」

stage0062_04:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Let's go!
　I'll protect $$カミナシティ$$, no matter what!」

stage0062_04:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Let's do this, $$ギミー$$!
　I won't let them have their way with us!」

stage0062_04:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$ダリー$$
「Of course!
　$$カミナシティ$$ is our city!」

stage0062_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$ギミー$$
「OK, $$ダリー$$!
　Let's show them the Dai-Gurren Brigade's spirit!!」

stage0062_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$竜馬$$
（Are you watching, $$カミナ$$?
　The man carrying your spirit just grew again.）

stage0062_04:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$竜馬$$
（And while you're at it!
　Take a look at how much stronger I've gotten!）
